# traffic-mock-recorder

> Record outbound HTTP traffic through a Go RoundTripper with redaction and caps, infer path templates from what was seen, and serve the result as a mock http.Handler. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u255-traffic-mock-recorder`, package `trafficmockrecorder`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): recorder, synthesis, and mock handler
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): tests and commands
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, and out-of-scope
